seasons.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for ornamental crops
seasons.note: Planted October-February; used here as a flowering hedge on the border.

spacing_plant_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for ornamental crops
spacing_plant_cm.quote: The plants generally planted in two row system at a planting distance of 60x100 cm, leaving 150 cm space between two rows.

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for ornamental crops
water_need.quote: Irrigation is applied at 10-15 days interval in winter
water_need.note: Every 10-15 days in winter and 5-6 days in summer: read as 'medium'. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for ornamental crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: Flower yield is around 30 quintals per acre.

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table (SLBC); other values are TNAU/PAU guides (Tamil Nadu, Punjab) until a local source is found.
